substeps.label: B6 · cool, de-inert, depowder
substeps.caption: Let it cool under gas, raise the platform, and vacuum the loose powder off (it goes back to the sieve).

substeps.label: B7 · panels out, photographed
substeps.caption: Unscrew the panels and photograph squares 1 and 2 from above with their IDs, before anything is cut.

substeps.label: C1 · number every part
substeps.caption: The six parts look alike. Before cutting, write square.part on each base with a paint pen (1.1 is square 1, part 1) and mark the wall-1 end. Write down which panel was square 1.

substeps.label: C1 · bandsaw the parts off
substeps.caption: Stand the panel on its edge and bandsaw about 1 mm into the panel, under the bases, not through them: the base is only about 2.5 mm thick, and the walls' roots must stay whole. The panel is used up.
substeps.watch_out: the bases are only about 2.5 mm thick. Cut in the panel, not the base, so every wall's root stays whole.
